subject: general
question: Who won the purple cap for the maximum number of wickets in IPL 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kagiso Rabada.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kagiso Rabada **was the bowler for Delhi Capitals in** IPL 2020**, He pick up 30 wickets in 17 matches with 2 four-wicket hauls to win the Purple Cap as the highest wicket-taker of the season.
 
• The South African speedster scalped 30 wickets in 17 matches at a phenomenal strike rate of 13.13.
 
• RR spinner **Yuzvendra Chahal** wins Purple Cap with 27 wickets in 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bowlers participating in the Indian Premier League (IPL) will be deserving of the Purple Cap award in Cricket. 
 
• The Purple Cap is **awarded to the bowler who has emerged as the leading wicket-taker in a particular edition of the high-profile Indian Premier League (IPL)**.
 
• In case of a tie game, the Purple Cap is given to the bowler who has a superior economy rate.
